notes:
New
- Marker and Arrow tools in the Instagram and Prints editors, exported like text
- ⌘A selects every photo frame in an Instagram or Prints editor, and E sends every selected photo to the editor at once, skipping hidden frames

Improved
- When the preview cache is full, Meki keeps the previews background work still needs and pauses background builds; Clear cache frees them
- Sidecar updates for photos on an away drive wait without holding up previews, and only changes a sidecar can lack are queued

Fixed
- Meki Cloud sync on a single Mac no longer waits on a step meant for a second Mac, and fetches previews only for each photo’s cover
- The Cloud button shows originals waiting for an away drive, and Meki no longer starts sync passes that can send nothing
- Previews waiting to go up to Meki Cloud are kept only while Meki Cloud can take them, and are built again for the upload if they had to go
- Previews built only for the upload never push out previews you viewed
- Progress bars keep their count and total while a step waits for a device, and restore, archive import, archive verify and import Verify count only what was left
- A full preview cache never holds up Prepare for culling, Finding people or the photos you open, and an album’s cull run holds only that album’s photos
- Meki Cloud no longer loops on phone previews it can’t build
- Photos with a creator, copyright or credit keep their sidecar update queued
- Smaller fixes across tasks after relaunch, plugins and new projects
